b72bb7d69a90: Can you book conference rooms in Salesforce?
14481010013b: Not out of the box. Standard Salesforce has no room booking control. MultiDatePick Booking adds one: keep your rooms as records on any object, and people pick a room, pick one or many dates, click open time slots and book. Each booking saves as a record on your own booking object.
dd75355c538a: How do I stop two people booking the same meeting room?
46616d188f81: Set Conflict Behavior to Block. Taken slots are drawn as taken and cannot be clicked, and every save is checked again against existing bookings, so a clash never saves.
475351fd2b40: Can I do desk booking or desk hoteling in Salesforce?
4c5d8bf77f1c: Yes. Make each desk zone a resource with a Capacity Field and turn on Show Availability Count, so people see how many desks are left until the zone is full. Disable Time Slot Grid (Full-Day Mode) books desks for the whole day. The Desk Hoteling config in the Config Library is a ready starting point.
b0d4939b0b46: Can I see every room's schedule on one screen?
b3870c09d4e5: Yes. The Timeline view puts every room down the side and dates across the top, with multi-day holds drawn as one bar. The Utilization view shows how full each room is per day as a heatmap, and the Week view shows the day by hour.
d4bd63b8e5f7: Can one booking reserve several rooms at once?
c1b113db1aa1: Yes. Turn on Allow Booking Multiple Resources and people tick several rooms for the same slot in one action. Capacity Aggregation decides how capacity adds up across the rooms.
c7e446a61cdd: Can each room have its own hours and closures?
1675395fd763: Yes. Business Hours Start Field and Business Hours End Field read each room's hours from the room record. Blocked dates come from your own closure records, for a whole day or part of a day, and for every room or just one.
1fabb656dc17: Where can people book a room from?
258b3626ca89: Anywhere you place the Booking component: a record page, an App or Home page, a Screen Flow, or an Experience Cloud site page. On App, Home and Experience pages, set Config Name and Static Parent Record Id.
